name: h0.008-d4
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
ahdl_include "dut.va"
ahdl_include "device.va"
Xmeasure (vin q high_mv low_mv rise_ns fall_ns) dut
Xcmp (vin q) hysteresis_device hysteresis=0.008 delay=4e-09
simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-9
tran tran stop=1.5u maxstep=0.1n
saveOptions options save=allpub
